transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; what brings you in to see me today?

Um... I'm just here because of work. Dispatch and compliance, they've been... tracking my route changes. Through the computer system. And they make these little comments on the radio. People keep telling me it's just normal oversight, but... I don't know. I can just tell certain drivers are reporting on me.
Do you ever hear voices or sounds that other people around you cannot hear?
Um... no. Not really. Just... just the radio. What they say on dispatch. Nothing else.
Have there been periods in your life where your mood was extremely high or low, lasting for several days or weeks?
No. I don't... I don't think so. My mood is just normal, I guess. I just try to do my job.
